description: The static method that creates and returns the object for a class call. It receives the class as `cls`.
The method that initializes the object `__new__` returned. It must return `None`.
Returning one shared instance per value (`Currency('EUR') is Currency('EUR')`) instead of building equal copies.
A subclass of `int`, `float`, `str` or `tuple`. Its value is fixed by `__new__`, so conversion and validation must happen there.
An `__init__` that is safe to run again on an existing object, which happens whenever `__new__` returns a cached instance.
A method that receives the class as `cls` instead of an instance; the usual way to write an alternative constructor such as `Currency.from_symbol("€")`.
